title: Has Done Her Sex Good Service

verses.t: "Florence Bolton ... has done her sex good service in this terse, well-arranged little volume. The directions for specific exercises, mainly of the 'mat' order, are well detailed, and fitting illustrations simplify their use."--The Record-Herald, Chicago, Ill.
_12mo, Cloth. Numerous half-tones and diagrams, outlining the movements. $1.00, net. Average carriage charges 8 cents._

FUNK & WAGNALLS COMPANY, Publishers
NEW YORK and LONDON
